---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

A one or two sentence description of the feature.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature solves and who would benefit from it. Concrete examples are more helpful than abstract descriptions.

## Proposed Behavior

How should the feature work? Include example commands and expected output if applicable.

```bash
# Example command
portscan-dev --your-new-flag

# Expected output
...
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any workarounds or alternative approaches? Why is this the right solution?

## Additional Context

Anything else that would help evaluate or implement this request.
